DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.name: Contrast
DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.definition: If two elements are not the same, make them clearly different — never almost the same. Contrast creates hierarchy and pulls the eye to what matters.
DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.definitionZh: 如果两个元素不一样，就让它们明显不一样，绝不似是而非。对比建立层次，把视线引向最重要的东西。
DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.mnemonic: Don't be timid — if elements differ, make them differ boldly.
DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.mnemonicZh: 别犹豫——元素要有别，就让差异够大。

checklist.en: Headings and body text have an obvious jump in size and weight, not a subtle one.
checklist.zh: 标题和正文在字号、字重上有明显的跳变，而不是细微差别。

checklist.en: Primary and secondary actions carry clearly different visual weight.
checklist.zh: 主次操作的视觉重量明显不同。

checklist.en: Key information stands out by size, color, or weight — not by italics alone.
checklist.zh: 关键信息靠大小、颜色或字重跳出，而不是只靠斜体。

DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.name: Repetition
DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.definition: Repeat visual elements — color, shape, type, spacing — throughout the design. Repetition builds unity and makes a layout feel like one system instead of scattered parts.
DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.definitionZh: 在整个设计中重复视觉元素——颜色、形状、字体、间距。重复建立统一感，让布局像一个系统，而不是零散的拼凑。
DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.mnemonic: Reuse the same tokens everywhere — consistency reads as intention.
DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.mnemonicZh: 到处复用同一套 token——一致会被读成「刻意」。

checklist.en: Radius, shadow, and spacing all come from one shared token set.
checklist.zh: 圆角、阴影、间距都取自同一套共享 token。

checklist.en: Elements of the same kind share the same style — every card looks like a card.
checklist.zh: 同类元素样式一致——每张卡片都像卡片。

checklist.en: Brand color and type recur across sections to tie the page together.
checklist.zh: 品牌色和字体在各区块反复出现，把页面串成一体。

DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.name: Alignment
DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.definition: Every element should have a visual connection to something else on the page. Nothing is placed arbitrarily — shared edges and baselines create an invisible order the eye trusts.
DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.definitionZh: 页面上每个元素都该和别的元素有视觉连接。没有东西是随手一放的——共享的边线和基线建立起一种眼睛信赖的隐形秩序。
DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.mnemonic: Nothing floats — put everything on a shared edge or baseline.
DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.mnemonicZh: 没有东西该飘着——一切都落在共享的边线或基线上。

checklist.en: Elements share alignment edges instead of each sitting on its own.
checklist.zh: 元素共享对齐边，而不是各自为政。

checklist.en: Avoid mixing centered and left-aligned text in the same block.
checklist.zh: 同一区块里避免居中与左对齐混用。

checklist.en: A grid or shared left edge constrains where things land.
checklist.zh: 用网格或共享左边线约束元素的落点。

DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.name: Proximity
DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.definition: Group related items close together and push unrelated ones apart. Proximity turns scattered elements into a few clear units, cutting the work the reader's eye has to do.
DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.definitionZh: 把相关的东西聚拢、把无关的推远。亲密性把零散元素归并成几个清晰的单元，减少读者眼睛要做的功。
DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.mnemonic: Closeness equals relationship — group by meaning, not by gut.
DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.mnemonicZh: 靠近 = 相关——按含义分组，而不是凭手感。

checklist.en: A label sits tight against the input it describes, not floating between two.
checklist.zh: 标签紧贴它所描述的输入框，而不是漂在两者之间。

checklist.en: Related items form a group with more whitespace between groups than within.
checklist.zh: 相关项成组，组与组之间的留白大于组内留白。

checklist.en: Lonely, ungrouped elements are pulled into the unit they belong to.
checklist.zh: 孤立、未分组的元素被归入它所属的单元。

HIERARCHY_LEVERS.name: Size
HIERARCHY_LEVERS.desc: Bigger elements are seen first — size is the loudest signal in the room.
HIERARCHY_LEVERS.descZh: 更大的元素先被看到——大小是房间里最响亮的信号。

HIERARCHY_LEVERS.name: Weight
HIERARCHY_LEVERS.desc: Heavier strokes carry more visual mass and hold the eye longer.
HIERARCHY_LEVERS.descZh: 更重的笔画有更大的视觉质量，留住视线更久。

HIERARCHY_LEVERS.name: Color
HIERARCHY_LEVERS.desc: High contrast against the background jumps forward; muted tones recede.
HIERARCHY_LEVERS.descZh: 与背景高对比的跳到前面，灰暗的色调后退。

HIERARCHY_LEVERS.name: Space
HIERARCHY_LEVERS.desc: Whitespace and isolation give an element room to command attention.
HIERARCHY_LEVERS.descZh: 留白与隔离给元素空间去掌控注意力。

SAMPLE_ELEMENTS.label: A short paragraph that supports the headline without competing with it.
SAMPLE_ELEMENTS.labelZh: 一段支撑标题、又不与它争抢的简短说明。
